name: ChatDOC-OCRFlux-bench-single
description: A benchmark for document-questioning and OCR-based document understanding that evaluates model ability to extract and answer questions from scanned or photographed documents. Designed to test multimodal pipelines combining OCR and language understanding on single-document instances.
reputation: Published and hosted on Hugging Face; used by researchers working on document-VQA and OCR+LLM systems but not as ubiquitous as major VQA benchmarks.
